correctness.rationale: For the ordinary unitary two-dimensional irrep pi(r)=diag(zeta^k,zeta^-k), pi(s)=swap, normalized vector and 2n group-element-labelled projectors, Pauli coordinates give identity eigenvalue n. Rotations/reflections cancel cross terms. For order ell=ord(zeta^{2k})>2 the traceless eigenvalues are nd^2,2n|c|^2 twice; at ell=2 they are nd^2,4n(Re c)^2,4n(Im c)^2. Their trace is n, hence min <=n/3; equality is attained precisely at d^2=1/3, and additionally phase arg c ≡pi/4 mod pi/2 if ell=2. Exceptional iff n divisible 4,k=n/4. Tight operator identity implies rank-one complex projective 2-design with multiplicity and condition number sqrt3. Independent direct orbit projector four-dimensional Gram matrices at (n,k)=(5,1),(8,2),(12,2),(6,1) reproduced eigenvalues n/3,n/3,n/3,n (within floating precision), including exceptional locked phase.
